title: Alleged ex-NPA commander yields in Caraga; arms cache seized

blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY, Philippines — An alleged former commander of the New People’s Army (NPA) surrendered to police authorities in Caraga on Monday, leading to the recovery of an arms cache in Cabadbaran City, Agusan del Norte, the Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) said on Tuesday. In a statement, PRO-13 director Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon identified the surrenderer only as alias “Mikey,” 44, a resident of Cabadbaran City. He said that Mikey was a former commanding officer of the Sandatahang Yunit Pampropaganda–Interyor (SYP-I) under the Headquarters Force of the NPA’s Northeastern Mindanao Regional Committee (NEMRC).
